Overpass (re-queried) shows the 2-circuit 230 kV way/185380583 leaving it for SC, and the 115 kV lines (way/1015932064 to Goshen and way/185380584 to SC) also end here, so it is the 230/115 kV McIntosh named in SERTP 2014.
